```{r}
b_cubed_palette <- c(
  "#005957", # donker teal (primary)
  "#6CDDB4", # licht mint / accent
  "#2E7D32",
  "#43A047",
  "#81C784",
  "#C8E6C9",
  "#FFFFFF"
)

library(ggplot2)

theme_bcubed <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}

scale_fill_bcubed <- function(...) {
  scale_fill_manual(values = b_cubed_palette, ...)
}

scale_color_bcubed <- function(...) {
  scale_color_manual(values = b_cubed_palette, ...)
}

library(scales)

n <- length(unique(df_top$publisher))

gradient_palette <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#6B3F2A",  # bruin
  "#FFFFFF",  # wit
  "#005957"   # B-Cubed groen
))(n)
```

PART 1: Belgium download

```{r}
#read in data

library(dplyr)

#filter toevoegen voor Vlaanderen

data_all_Flanders <- read.csv("~/GitHub/Flanders_use_case/_preprocessing/data/raw/data_all_Flanders.csv")

overzicht <- data_all_Flanders %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE))

library(ggplot2)

overzicht$year <- as.numeric(as.character(overzicht$year))

b <- ggplot(overzicht, aes(x = year, y = total_records)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color= "#005957") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(min(overzicht$year), max(overzicht$year), by = 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Number of Records"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)+
  theme_bcubed()
```

```{r}

df <- data_all_Flanders

df$year <- as.numeric(as.character(df$year))

debug <- df%>%
  group_by(year)%>%
  summarise(total_records=sum(n_records))

top_publishers <- df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  group_by(publisher) %>%
  summarise(totaal = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(totaal)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  pull(publisher)

df_top <- df %>%
  filter(year >= 2000, publisher %in% top_publishers) %>%
  group_by(year, publisher) %>%
  summarise(totaal_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

library(ggplot2)

library(scales)

n <- n_distinct(df_top$publisher)

gradient_palette <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#6B3F2A",
  "#FFFFFF",
  "#005957",
  "#6CDDB4",
  '#48A529',
  '#000000'
))(n)


a <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = year, y = totaal_records, fill = publisher)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gradient_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Publishers by Number of Records (Since 2000)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of records",
    fill = "Publisher"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "plain")
  )+
  theme_minimal()

top_publishers <- df %>%
  group_by(publisher) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(`n_records`, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_records)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_publishers

library('forcats')

top_publishers <- top_publishers %>%
  mutate(publisher = fct_reorder(publisher, total_records))

 b <-  ggplot(top_publishers, aes(x = total_records, y = publisher)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#005957") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = scales::comma(total_records)),
    hjust = -0.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "Total records per publisher",
    x = "Total records",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

write.csv(top_publishers, "~/GitHub/Flanders_use_case/_preprocessing/data/raw/top_publishers.csv")
```

PART II: Flanders download

```{r}
library('rgbif')
library('sf')

dl <- occ_download_get(
  key = "0000799-260623161305970"
)

dat <- occ_download_import(
  dl
)

#only select for gridcells in Flanders

Flanders <- read_sf('./_preprocessing/data/raw/spatial/EEA_1km_Flanders_union.geojson')

dat_Flanders <- dat%>%
  filter(eeacellcode%in%Flanders$CELLCODE)

dat_Flanders_sum <- dat_Flanders %>%
  group_by(kingdom, year) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(occurrences), .groups = "drop")%>%
  filter(year>1974)

n <- n_distinct(dat_Flanders_sum$kingdom)

gradient_palette <- colorRampPalette(c(
  "#6B3F2A",
  "#FFFFFF",
  "#005957",
  "#6CDDB4",
  '#48A529',
  '#000000'
))(n)


test <- ggplot(dat_Flanders_sum, aes(x = year, y = total_records, fill = kingdom)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gradient_palette) +
  labs(
    title = "Records per year by kingdom",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Total number of records",
    fill = "Kingdom"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

dat_Flanders_sum <- dat_Flanders %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(occurrences))%>%
  filter(year>1974)

dat_prop <- dat_Flanders %>%
  filter(year>1974)%>%
  group_by(kingdom) %>%
  summarise(total_records = sum(occurrences), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(proportion = total_records / sum(total_records))

test <- ggplot(dat_prop, aes(x = kingdom, y = proportion)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Proportion of records per kingdom",
    x = "Kingdom",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
